case_data.title: SheAI
case_data.provide-a-brief-description-of-the-proje: SheAI is bridging the gender gap in artificial intelligence through accessible, community-driven education. We offer personalized learning experiences in business & entrepreneurship, AI governance & ethics, and technical engineering, empowering women at every career stage to not just learn about AI, but to shape its future.
case_data.what-limitations-to-the-project-should-b: SheAI promotes inclusion by reducing barriers to AI education for women through beginner-friendly learning, free resources, scholarships, community support, and partnerships that extend opportunities to disadvantaged groups globally. While its commitment to gender equity is clear, there is limited evidence on the website of specific digital accessibility initiatives for people with disabilities.
case_data.inclusion-efforts:
Addressing the gender gap in AI: SheAI's core mission is to increase women's participation in AI by providing education, networking, and career development opportunities. It explicitly aims to create more opportunities for women to learn, use, and lead in AI. 
Accessible learning for beginners: The platform is designed for people with no technical background, using bite-sized, practical courses and step-by-step guidance to make AI more approachable. 
The platform has learners from more than 50 countries and is building local community hubs and ambassador programmes to support women worldwide.
case_data.why-is-this-project-important-to-include: We're actively working to include more diverse voices in product design, leadership positions, and AI expertise. As a part of United Nations AI for Good, all of our educational courses come with official certification that can help to boost anyCV or LInkedIn profile.
project-goals: Capacity: Build participant capacity to engage with AI
case_data.describe-the-subject-matter-in-your-own-: SheAI is an inclusive AI learning initiative designed to close the gender gap in artificial intelligence through accessible education, ethical AI training, and a supportive global community.
